g.text: Which triggers will you use? Each names its own provider; your answer picks the key
asked for and the path the test runs.
-i- -iok- -ip- -if- · the draft goes to a cloud API; asks for its key
-il- -ilm- · PROMPT_LOCAL_ONLY=true: the cloud triggers then refuse
every trigger above; asks for the cloud key
Local saves PROMPT_LOCAL_ONLY=true: -i-, -iok-, -ip-, -if- then answer with a refusal
marker instead of calling OpenRouter. The triggers to use are -il- (Ollama) or -ilm-
(LM Studio). It refuses every provider that would send the draft off this computer (a
server elsewhere, an Ollama cloud model); it cannot see a local server that passes the
draft on. Cloud or both turn it off again.
